messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Canary error rate spike for "inference-api" (us-east canary). 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 6.8% in 5m. Latency p99 increased from 220ms -> 1.8s. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1749754321

alex (oncall): on it, joining. Paging oncall. @lina @maya can you confirm recent deploys/flags?

lina (eng-release): deployed v2.3.4 ~8m ago, enabled feature flag `new-rerank` at 10% for us-east canary only. No DB migrations. Logs showed a few model queue backpressure warnings during rollout.

maya (sre): seeing 5xx from inference worker pool, stacktrace points to OOM + retry storms on model container. p50/p95 fine, p99 hammered. Suggest flip flag off and drain canary traffic.

alex (oncall): flipping flag now via Console -> Feature Flags -> new-rerank -> 0% :white_check_mark:

lina (eng-release): confirmed, flag `new-rerank` set to 0%. updating rollout dashboard.

simon (eng-runtime): still seeing crashloops on a subset of canary pods; logs show `KVCacheMemExceeded` followed by rapid restarts. If flag off doesn't stabilize within 30s we'll do manual rollback.

alex (oncall): initiating manual rollback to v2.3.3 to be safe. Running `redwoodctl rollback inference-api --to v2.3.3 --region us-east --no-wait`

simon (eng-runtime): executed rollback. output:
```
Started rollback: inference-api -> v2.3.3
Scaling down replicaSet v2.3.4-canary
Creating pods for v2.3.3
Pods restarting... 3/3 up (ready)
Traffic shifted back to stable
```

incident-bot: Auto-monitor: 5xx rate dropping (6.8% -> 0.5%) over last 45s, latency p99 -> 260ms.

jordan (pm): any customer impact? which customers saw failures?

lee (support): support queue shows 2 tickets flagged as high priority: TCK-8421 (AcmeCorp) and TCK-8429 (Finly). Both report degraded throughput and 5xx responses during 16:40-16:50 UTC. I've informed them we rolled back; will follow-up.

alex (oncall): smoke-checking endpoints: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate` -> `200 0.28s`. Re-checking canary metrics now.

lina (eng-release): running a constrained canary rerun with additional mem limits and extra logging before any re-enable: plan -> 1) increase container memory 2) enable verbose cache metrics 3) start at 1% for 20m. Will open PR and schedule a canary window.

maya (sre): recommend postmortem capture: memory profile from model process, KV cache eviction logs, and rollout timing. I'll create an incident ticket and add the graphs.

alex (oncall): handing off to lina & maya for follow-up and postmortem. I'll stay available for any hot reverts. Action items: lina -> PR + constrained canary; simon -> collect model container heap dumps; maya -> incident ticket + alerts tuning.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated by oncall (alex). Creating incident-1749754321 in tracker.

lina (eng-release): thanks team :thumbsup: will post timeline + postmortem draft once we have traces.

lee (support): sending customer update drafts now.

alex (oncall): closing thread here — ping me if errors resurface.
